rationale.conceptual: The method applies a well-known phase equilibrium computation (CALPHAD) with a minor variation (adding curvature excess energy). It does not require new algorithmic derivations; a competent agent can implement the solver using standard thermodynamic libraries.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of loading a database and performing a loop over radii to solve equilibrium equations, producing a single CSV. No multi-stage orchestration, no fragile dependencies, and straightforward I/O.

difficulty.reasoning: A standard CALPHAD equilibrium calculation with a curvature-induced energy shift; trivial single-step pipeline and negligible resource needs.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Only a few equilibrium solves on a tiny thermodynamic database; CPU‑only and negligible memory footprint.
